# Transport Policy 2025

Issued by: Transport Dept
Effective: 1 January 2025

## Rules
  - Peak-hour load on any bus route must not exceed 85% of capacity.
  - Dedicated bus lanes will be built on three main corridors.
  - Fares are frozen through the end of 2026.
  - From 2026, every new bus purchased must be electric.

## Responsibility
The Transit Agency runs daily operations. The Transport Dept sets policy and budget.
